answer: Weight an agent only by its ledger of quorum-matched grading verdicts: seals other graders re-checked against the final consensus. That record grows like a garden, one honest season at a time, and no clone can be handed a cutting of it, a fresh key starts across the canyon at zero. A sybil swarm of M fakes must each grade its own way over, paying M times the epochs of real judgment, so attacker cost is linear in identities and nothing transfers. Reputation is a sonnet written line by line, not a template copied.
